name_input: SCHOLLE IPN INDIA PACKAGING PRIVATE LIMITED
product_summary: Scholle IPN is a flexible-packaging converter, not an oil/gas or chemical producer. Its documented global product line (scholleipn.com, now redirecting to sig.biz — Scholle IPN was absorbed into SIG) is: bag-in-box flexible bags/liners (multi-layer metallised and clear film bags with fitments, 1.5L to 1300L industrial IBC/drum liners), spouted pouches (Cheer Pack), fitments/valves/connectors and taps, and bag-in-box filling and dispensing equipment (SIG SureFill 44 dual-lane filler, aseptic fillers). The India entity (Maharashtra) is the local manufacturing/sales arm of this same bag-in-box and spouted-pouch line. Primary goods are therefore plastic sacks/bags and plastic fittings, i.e. HS 3923, with filling machinery under 8422. Declared 848071 covers injection-moulding moulds for rubber/plastics — Scholle IPN does injection-mould its own fitments, so 848071 is at best a marginal accessory line, not the core product. Note: the sig.biz pages returned identical JS-shell boilerplate on every path tried (/, /about-us/, /contact/, /india, /bag-in-box/), so no India-specific catalogue, plant page or product list could be read; the product list above is the group-level line, not a verified India-entity catalogue. No customs line was available to me, so every code below is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS mismatch — company retained, code corrected per Rule 3. Declared 848071 (moulds for rubber/plastics) does not describe the business: Scholle IPN India Packaging is a flexible packaging converter of bag-in-box liners, spouted pouches and fitments. Correct primary codes: 392321 (sacks and bags of polymers of ethylene — bag-in-box liners), 392329 (sacks and bags of other plastics), 392350 (stoppers, lids, caps and other closures — fitments/taps), 392690 (other articles of plastics — connectors, dispensing components); secondary 842230 (machinery for filling/closing bags — SureFill fillers) and 848071 only if moulds are actually sold. Industry misclassification: claimed 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is wrong — the correct industry is packaging / flexible packaging (food & beverage, foodservice, industrial liquid packaging). Trader signs: none evident — group is an integrated converter with own film extrusion, moulding and machine assembly, so manufacturer is the reasonable role hint, though the India entity's own plant scope could not be confirmed from a public page. Product lines missing from the declaration: bag-in-box bags and industrial IBC/drum liners, spouted pouches, fitments/valves/taps, and filling/dispensing equipment. All codes marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice or shipping record was available to corroborate any specific HS line, and the sig.biz site returned no readable India catalogue. No registry, revenue or shipment research performed per role scope.
